title: How is Queen Elizabeth II connected to Freddy Fazbear?
description:
Five real pictures connect Queen Elizabeth II to Freddy Fazbear from Five Nights at Freddy's.

Elizabeth II → Barack Obama → Jimmy Kimmel → Conan O'Brien → Josh Hutcherson → Freddy Fazbear

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Queen Elizabeth II → Barack Obama: In 2009, Queen Elizabeth the Second welcomed Barack Obama to Buckingham Palace.
   Photo by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Barack_Obama_Michelle_Obama_Queen_Elizabeth_II_Buckingham_Palace_London.jpg
2. Barack Obama → Jimmy Kimmel: In 2015, Obama was a guest on Jimmy Kimmel's late-night show.
   Photo by Pete Souza, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Barack_Obama_talks_with_Jimmy_Kimmel_during_a_Jimmy_Kimmel_Live!_video_taping_in_Los_Angeles,_California,_March_12,_2015._(Official_White_House_Photo_by_Pete_Souza).jpg
3. Jimmy Kimmel → Conan O'Brien: In 2018, Kimmel shared a Los Angeles stage with fellow host Conan O'Brien.
   Photo by Raph_PH, CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:WillFerellGreekLA061018-21.jpg
4. Conan O'Brien → Josh Hutcherson: At Comic-Con 2015, Conan hosted a Hunger Games panel with Josh Hutcherson.
   Photo by Gage Skidmore from Peoria, AZ, United States of America, CC BY-SA 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:SDCC_2015_-_Conan_O%27Brien,_Francis_Lawrence,_Josh_Hutcherson,_Jennifer_Lawrence_%26_Liam_Hemsworth_(19035435903).jpg
5. Josh Hutcherson → Freddy Fazbear: In 2023, Hutcherson starred opposite Freddy Fazbear.
   Photo by Universal Pictures / Blumhouse (film still), Fair use (commentary): https://freddy-fazbears-pizza.fandom.com/wiki/File:FNaF_Movie_-_Freddy_behind_Mike.png

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#elizabethii #freddyfazbear #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
